articles.title: Text-to-Image Models and Their Representation of People from Different Nationalities Engaging in Activities
articles.description: This paper investigates how popular text-to-image (T2I) models, DALL-E 3 and Gemini 3 Pro Preview, depict people from 206 nationalities when prompted to generate images of individuals engaging in common everyday activities. Five scenarios were developed, and 2,060 images were generated using input prompts that specified nationalities across five activities. articles.title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
articles.description: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems, including nine Erdős problems two of which were unsolved for 56 years, per a study in Science. The publication comes as OpenAI faces a boycott for dumping AI proofs on GitHub without peer review. Deepmind had its results reviewed before publishing. The article Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed appeared first on The Decoder.
